description: This file provides a wrapper interface for pandas DataFrame operations, including creation, type checking, iteration, concatenation, and attribute access, with a mechanism to replace the underlying implementation.

classes.name: PandasWrapper
classes.description: A class providing static methods to handle pandas DataFrame operations, with runtime checks for pandas availability.

methods.name: create_dataframe
methods.description: Creates a pandas DataFrame from data and optional columns.

methods.name: is_dataframe
methods.description: Checks if the data is a pandas DataFrame.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Retrieves the list of column names from a DataFrame.

methods.name: is_column
methods.description: Checks if the data is a pandas Series (column).

methods.name: iterate
methods.description: Iterates over DataFrame rows as namedtuples.

methods.name: get_item
methods.description: Retrieves a slice of the DataFrame at a specific index.

methods.name: get_len
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in a DataFrame.

methods.name: set_df_wrapper
methods.description: Sets a custom wrapper class for DataFrame operations.

methods.name: get_df_wrapper
methods.description: Retrieves the current DataFrame wrapper class.
